notes.title: Update Mar 18th
notes.content:
Hey all space travelers!

We've updated OMEGA 6 The Triangle Stars to improve the overall experience.
The patch contains the following:
[*] Minor localisation fixes
[*] QOL update to change default text display speed to 'skippable'

Safe travels and happy gaming!
